definitions.meaning: A cloth for covering a seat

quotations.old_english: Ic gean tó Cristes weofede ánre lytlere goldenre róde and ánes sethrægles [an altar-cloth?]
Án lang healwáhrift and þríó sethrægl

source_text: set-hrægl, es; n. A cloth for covering a seat:-- Setrægl tapeta, Wrt. Voc. i. 82, 19. Ic gean tó Cristes weofede ánre lytlere goldenre róde and ánes sethrægles (an altar-cloth?], Chart. Th. 564, 10, 18. Án lang healwáhrift and þríó sethrægl, 538, 4. [Cf. Icel. set-klæði.] v. setl-hrægl.
